title: Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM): A Unified Learning-Based Framework for Noise Resilience in Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Error mitigation stands between variational quantum algorithms and useful results on today's noisy hardware, yet in practice a mitigation method is usually chosen once, by hand, and applied unchanged for the life of an experiment. This is a poor fit for quantum machine learning (QML), where the circuit and the noise drift as training proceeds, so the best strategy in one regime is often wrong in another. We present a generalized form of Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM), which treats the choice of mitigation technique as an online decision made from an algorithm's own feedback. A single contextual-bandit controller observes signals any variational algorithm already produces, such as fidelity, entropy, reward or loss, and gradient behavior, and selects among Zero-Noise Extrapolation, Probabilistic Error Cancellation, Measurement Error Mitigation, Dynamical Decoupling, and circuit optimization per step. translated_title: 自适应策略引导的错误缓解（APGEM）：一个面向量子机器学习噪声韧性的统一学习框架
translated_abstract: 错误缓解是当今含噪硬件上变分量子算法获得有用结果的关键环节，然而在实践中，缓解方法通常是一次性人工选定，并在实验的整个生命周期中一成不变地应用。这对量子机器学习（QML）来说并不合适，因为随着训练的进行，电路和噪声都会发生漂移，因此在一种情形下最优的策略在另一种情形下往往是错误的。我们提出了自适应策略引导错误缓解（APGEM）的广义形式，它将缓解技术的选择视为根据算法自身反馈做出的在线决策。一个单一的上下文老虎机（contextual-bandit）控制器观察任何变分算法本身已经产生的信号，例如保真度、熵、奖励或损失以及梯度行为，并在零噪声外推、概率误差消除、测量误差缓解、动态解耦和电路优化之间逐步进行选择。由于它依赖于……（原文在此截断）
tldr: APGEM提出了一种基于上下文老虎机的自适应框架，利用变分量子算法自身产生的反馈信号在线动态选择错误缓解技术，从而解决了量子机器学习训练过程中因电路与噪声漂移导致固定缓解策略失效的问题。
en_tdlr: APGEM introduces a unified learning-based framework that employs a contextual-bandit controller to adaptively select error mitigation techniques online based on the variational algorithm's own feedback signals, addressing the failure of static mitigation strategies under circuit and noise drift in quantum machine learning.
